risks.desc: A consumer may resolve an unpinned or mismatched schema version and report conformance against the wrong contract.
risks.mitigation: Require exact pin identity and deterministic conformance assertion mapping; keep mismatch rejection as a named negative.

risks.desc: A read-only projection could be misread as authority to mutate the runtime schema or provider state.
risks.mitigation: Preserve runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false, read-only projection semantics and the global NO-GO authority boundary.

rollback: Row-to-node parity, exact dependency, schedule or negative-boundary evidence drift withdraws this descendant application; pre-D01 baseline and runtime state stay unchanged while projections are regenerated.
